subject: [video] WP06 note for probe run 2: T11 follows T10, so H.264 failure cascades; T10b is the useful half until n2avc lands
body: Reading run 2: with no working H.264 encoder yet, T10 will fail at startWriting or the first append (keys t10.startWriting / t10.append.video / t10.status / t10.error now always say which). T11 reads t10.mp4 exactly as TASK.md specifies, so while t10.mp4 is absent it fails at t11.track.video=0 and reports t11.tracks=0; that is a cascade, not a second AVFoundation problem. T10b (HEVC to t10b.mov, timeout now 120 s for the ~350 ms/frame software encoder) and T12/T12a are independent. If you want the reader exercised in run 2 regardless, I can add either (a) T11 falls back to t10b.mov when t10.mp4 has no video track, reporting t11.fallback=t10b.mov, or (b) a separate av.read.hevc on t10b.mov. Say which; both are small and stay in probe/av. Otherwise I leave T11 as the task wrote it. No other WP06 change.
